technology: Smart doorbell camera that records the front door and shares clips to a phone app

scenarios.title: The “suspicious” driver
scenarios.story: Sam delivers 120 parcels a day. At one house, a clip of Sam leaving a parcel is posted to a neighbourhood app with the caption “suspicious”. Sam only finds out when a customer mentions it.
scenarios.later: Most homes on Sam’s route now have cameras. The delivery company starts using customers’ clips to rate how fast and how carefully drivers work.
scenarios.widespread: Every doorstep records workers. Delivery work is watched all day by people who are not the employer.
scenarios.systemic: Employers lean on customers’ cameras instead of their own policies. Complaints arrive as video that workers can’t see or answer.

scenarios.title: The morning walk
scenarios.story: Ana walks her dog past the same houses every morning. Three of them have doorbell cameras that also capture the pavement. She has never noticed them.
scenarios.later: Clips from thousands of doorbells can be searched by time and place. Anyone with access could piece together Ana’s daily routine.
scenarios.widespread: If every front door records the street, there is no unrecorded public space left.
scenarios.systemic: Police and insurers come to expect footage. Not having a camera starts to look careless, or suspicious.

scenarios.title: Peace of mind
scenarios.story: Jo works late and checks the app to see her teenager get home safely. It’s the first thing she looks at.
scenarios.later: Her teenager has learned to come in through the back door so they aren’t logged.
scenarios.widespread: Families everywhere track each other’s comings and goings by default.
scenarios.systemic: Trust at home shifts from conversation to checking. Not being watched starts to need a reason.

tensions.note: Jo’s sense of safety depends on recording the doorstep, which also records Ana, who never agreed to it (safety vs privacy).
Homeowners gain proof of delivery; drivers lose dignity and become judged by clips they can’t answer.
